messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: Elevated 5xx rate observed for /v1/generate in eu-west-1 — latency up and tail errors increasing. Auto-alert threshold breached (5m window).
maya: I’m oncall, looking now. any customer reports yet?
sam: seeing a spike in NGINX 502/504s in the LB logs, might be backend overload. I can attach tail logs.
maya: thx. sam, can you post the last 20 lines from the inference proxy?
sam: ```
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z proxy ERROR upstream timeout id=0x7f...
2026-03-15T09:12:04Z proxy WARN kv cache miss seq=1024
2026-03-15T09:12:05Z runtime ERROR oom killing worker pid=4123 model=redwood-v1
```
alina: customer support flagged 3 incidents (prod, enterprise) — two customers see degraded responses and one has timeouts on batch calls. they ask ETA.
maya: initial triage: probable worker OOMs + queue buildup leading to 502s. mitigation attempt 1: reduce max_concurrency on proxy from 20 -> 8 for eu-west pool to reduce pressure. doing now.
maya: `kubectl -n inference patch hpa eu-west-proxy --patch '{"spec": {"maxReplicas": 6}}'` (running)
jordan: if we drop concurrency we might increase latency but reduce failures. good short-term. can we also evict large KV entries? last incident showed stale KV growth. ops runbook has a safe eviction cmd.
sam: running eviction script against cache-shard-3 now: `curl -X POST https://ops/evict?shard=3&percent=30`
incident-bot: mitigation note recorded: reduced proxy concurrency; eviction started; monitor CPU/GPU and tail errors.
maya: monitoring metrics — errors trending down from 18% -> 6% in last 4m. throughput slightly reduced.
alina: patch customers: emailed two affected customers with P1 status, asked for logs and whether they hit rate limits.
sam: follow-up: one worker still OOMing occasionally, looks like a specific model variant with long context. suspect quantized model memory regression after yesterday’s build.
jordan: can we fallback that tenant to model-variant-v2-lite? Risk: potential quality change but keeps availability.
maya: agree. sam, can you patch routing rule for tenant-103 to force v2-lite?
sam: done: `PATCH /routing/tenant-103 {"pool": "eu-west", "model": "v2-lite"}` -> 200 OK.
maya: status: errors down to 1.2% over 10m. paging to oncall resolved. moving to post-incident handoff. :white_check_mark:
alina: scheduling postmortem: proposed slot tomorrow 14:00 UTC. owners: maya (lead), sam (runtime), jordan (routing), alina (customer-impact).
maya: creating action items and sizing now — will dump here for triage and quarterly tie-in.
maya: ACTION-1: Root-cause debug: verify memory regression from build 2026-03-14 and produce repro. owner: sam. estimate: 3d (S). severity: Sev-2.
maya: ACTION-2: Add post-deploy memory smoke test for large-context variants to CI (block merge). owner: jordan. estimate: 2d (M). severity: Sev-3. quarterly tie-in: Q2 reliability sprint.
maya: ACTION-3: Routing policy enhancement: automated fallback when OOM rate > 0.5% over 5m (canary then roll). owner: maya. estimate: 5d (L). severity: Sev-2. tie-in: Dedicated reliability epic.
maya: ACTION-4: Customer remediation & credits: coordinate with support for impacted tenants and confirm compensation. owner: alina. estimate: 1d (S). severity: Sev-3.
remediation-tracker: New remediation ticket created: RT-2026-1127 -> https://tracker/redwood/RT-2026-1127 (linked to incident 1954321098).
alina: quick sizing note — ACTION-3 could be split into design (2d) + implementation (3d) — I recommend breaking during grooming.
jordan: we should also add observability alert changes: include per-model OOM rate metric. small task. ACTION-5: add per-model OOM telemetry + dashboard. owner: jordan. estimate: 2d (M). severity: Sev-3.
sam: blocked item: need repro dataset for memory regression. will ask research to provide small repro job.
maya: next steps: I’ll run full incident writeup + severity justification, schedule postmortem (tomorrow 14:00 UTC), and assign the action items into the remediation tracker. please add estimates/comments here before EOD.
alina: noted. ping me once tickets are in tracker and I’ll loop in account owners for remediation comms.
jordan: adding a note for Q2 planning: ACTION-3 and ACTION-2 map to reliability sprint; mark as candidate for prioritized commit.
maya: thanks all — marking incident as mitigated and handing to postmortem queue. If no objections, I’ll close the page and move items to RT-2026-1127.
sam: no objections.
alina: go ahead.
incident-bot: Incident 1954321098 marked mitigated by maya at 2026-03-15T09:29:20Z. Postmortem scheduled.
maya: closing thread — I’ll post the postmortem draft after the meeting and link RFC for routing fallback.
remediation-tracker: RT-2026-1127 updated with ACTION-1..5, owners, estimates. https://tracker/redwood/RT-2026-1127/details
jordan: follow-up: add checklist item to oncall runbook: "if OOM >1% during peak, reduce proxy concurrency then evaporate large KVs" — small doc change, I’ll PR.
maya: thanks everyone, good mitigation work. :heart:
